_comment: The production `vehicle_state` Postgres ENUM, verbatim and in enumsortorder.
This file exists so kernel-side code that names a production state can be
checked against the real vocabulary WITHOUT a test reaching a database.
It is a snapshot, not a runtime source: nothing reads it at runtime, and
changing it changes nothing about the running system.
query    SELECT e.enumlabel FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_enum e
When the enum changes, re-run that query and update this file in the same
